title: UCSC hg18 17-way phastCons conservation scores and conserved elements

provenance.observed_or_adapted: derived reference annotation; not primary experimental observations
provenance.source_identity: Pinned hg18 track description states that best-in-genome blastz pairwise alignments were chained/netted, assembled with multiz, and analyzed by phastCons using `--most-conserved`; linked UCSC hg18/phastCons17way directory describes compressed scores and conserved elements.
provenance.grouping_evidence: Score files and element annotations are identified by one hg18/17-way track release and linked download directory; the score file's per-base posterior probabilities and track's conserved intervals/log-odds remain distinct assets/stages within this product.

biological_context.assay: Comparative sequence conservation computed from multi-species genome alignment; no wet-lab assay
biological_context.design: Human hg18 reference with 16 comparator assembly alignments
metadata: Comparators: chimp panTro1, mouse mm8, rat rn4, rabbit oryCun1, macaque rheMac2, dog canFam2, cow bosTau2, armadillo dasNov1, elephant loxAfr1, tenrec echTel1, opossum monDom4, chicken galGal2, frog xenTro1, zebrafish danRer3, tetraodon tetNig1, fugu fr1
Track elements are HMM-derived conserved segments; score files are per-base posterior probability in the most-conserved state

assets.accession: Chromosome-specific compressed phastCons score files (e.g. chr1.gz)
assets.version: hg18, March 2006; phastCons17way directory; chromosome files listed as modified 2006-04-06
assets.format: gzip compressed phastCons score data; uncompressed fixedStep wiggle scores, one value per base with one-based start
assets.processing_stage: per-base posterior probability scores from phastCons most-conserved state
relationships: Derived from the same 17-way alignment/model run as corresponding conserved-element predictions; no individual files were inspected.

assets.format: UCSC positional conserved-element annotation table; exact schema not inspected
assets.processing_stage: interval calls from the phastCons `--most-conserved` output; element score transformed from raw log-odds to 0-1000, raw value retained in name field per track description
relationships: Derived element intervals from the same multiple-alignment/model product as the score files; logically linked but a different output representation.

access_and_terms.access: The directory index says its files are freely available for public use; track page also provides Table Browser and REST API access. The live directory was not downloaded.
access_and_terms.reuse_evidence: Directory says assembly genome data-use restrictions may apply and points to UCSC credits; the applicable historical human/comparator assembly terms were not individually reviewed. Do not infer redistribution or release rights from the directory's general availability statement.

inspection.read: Inspected pinned track description and Table Browser data access; read live directory metadata/species list and current phastCons file-format help. Did not download score assets.
unverified_claims: individual file values/hashes, current database table availability, element count, exact schema, and per-assembly use terms

limitations: hg18 is a legacy assembly and should be kept distinct from hg19/hg38; no liftover is included in this product.
The score and interval representations are related but not interchangeable: per-base scores are posterior probabilities, while element score fields are transformed log-odds.
Comparator list and build labels are source-reported; no independent genome reference or alignment file was inspected.
Reuse terms are incomplete for release decisions; source directory points to assembly-specific credits/restrictions.
No source files were downloaded or scientifically validated.
